config.description: Fine-tuning on real shots (hybrid training, step b) and scoring on the held-out test batch (step c). Decoder prior for MWPM: calibrated_coherence on the device patch with the readout-window extension, Ramsey T2, asymmetric readout and QND flips. Fine-tune on the finetune split of batches 1 and 2, early-stop on their validation split, weights pulled towards the pre-trained ones (l2_to_init). Then the two-layer cascade (Sal, 2026-10-25 ~00:00 UTC): the fine-tuned LSTM decides shots with confidence |2p - 1| >= tau, Relay-BP the rest, correlated MWPM where Relay-BP does not converge; tau tuned on the validation split only.

train.data: fixed datasets (fine-tuning), sampled by size, reshuffled epochs
train.stop_reason: early stop: no val improvement in 15 evaluations

prior_choice.rule: calibrated unless uniform-weight correlated MWPM fails fewer validation shots by more than sqrt(b + c), b and c the shots on which only one of the two fails
